Initial release: Screen addiction detection and analysis for teens.

- Monitors adolescent screen time and posture via fixed cameras at home, study rooms, or schools.
- Detects head pitch angle (down > 45°), hand-held device posture, and classifies behavior (screen use, reading, writing).
- Tracks continuous and daily screen-looking time; triggers reminders if thresholds (e.g., >30 min/session or >2 hours/day) are exceeded.
- Sends notifications and friendly reminders to parents via app or smart devices to promote healthy habits.
- Provides structured reports, addiction level assessment, and daily summaries for parental reference.
- Strict open-id (user identification) acquisition process for report management and history lookup.
- Designed for real-time monitoring, early intervention to prevent myopia, cervical-spine issues, and gaming addiction.
